Deep in the green lilac park
You held on to me like I was a crucifix
As we went kneeling through the dark

crucifix.linePrev: The earth squeals and shudders to a halt
crucifix.line: A diamond crucifix in his ear
crucifix.lineNext: Is used to help ward off the fear
stanza: The plotted lines the faulty map
That brought Columbus to New York
Betwixt between the East and West
He calls on her wearing a leather vest
The earth squeals and shudders to a halt
A diamond crucifix in his ear
Is used to help ward off the fear
That he has left his soul in someone's rented car
Inside his pants he hides a mop
To clean the mess that he has dropped
Into the life of lithesome Juliette Bell

When you are young, they assume you know nothing

politics.linePrev: Writin' names on my hollow tips, plottin' shit
politics.line: Mad violence, who I'm gon' body? This hood politics
politics.lineNext: Acknowledge it, leave bodies chopped up in garbages
stanza: Yo, all I need is one mic, one beat, one stage
One nigga front, my face on the front page
Only if I had one gun, one girl and one crib
One God to show me how to do things his son did
Pure, like a cup of virgin blood
Mixed with 151, one sip'll make a nigga flip
Writin' names on my hollow tips, plottin' shit
Mad violence, who I'm gon' body? This hood politics
Acknowledge it, leave bodies chopped up in garbages
Seeds watch us, grow up and try to follow us
Police watch us, roll up and try knockin' us
One knee, I ducked, could it be my time is up?
But my luck, I got up, the cop shot again
Bus stop glass burst, a fiend drops his Heineken
Ricochetin' between the spots that I'm hidin' in
Blackin' out as I shoot back, fuck gettin' hit
This is my hood, I'ma rep to the death of it
'Til everybody come home, little niggas is grown
We need more warriors soon, sent from the stars, sun and the moon
In this life of police chases, street sweepers and coppers
Stick-up kids with no conscience leavin' victims with doctors
If you really think you ready to die with nines out
This is what Nas is 'bout, nigga, the time is now

politics.songTitle: The Lonesome Death of Hattie Carroll
politics.linePrev: With rich wealthy parents who provide and protect him
politics.line: And high office relations in the politics of Maryland
politics.lineNext: Reacted to his deed with a shrug of his shoulders
stanza: William Zanzinger, who at twenty-four years
Owns a tobacco farm of six hundred acres
With rich wealthy parents who provide and protect him
And high office relations in the politics of Maryland
Reacted to his deed with a shrug of his shoulders
And swear words and sneering, and his tongue, it was a-snarling
And in a matter of minutes, on bail was out walking
